newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Aug. general fund revenues above forecast.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Aug. general fund revenues above forecast.

text.p: California general fund revenues in August were $45 million above the budget forecast of $3.2 billion, the state's Department of Finance said on Wednesday.

Personal income tax receipts were $35 million below the month's forecast, while sales and use tax receipts were $51 million below forecast. Bank and corporation tax receipts was $20 million above the month's forecast.
Trial court revenues were up $51 million through the first two months of the fiscal year, while the remaining revenues were $65 million above the August forecast, the department said.
